tbl_description: One row per water sample (Niskin bottle on a CTD cast, or an underway surface sample on P2107): position, depth, time, cast and bottle number, CCE Process cruises 2006-2024. Exact duplicates dropped; samples with a conflicting key, no time or position, or no depth held out (Q02-Q04).
Particulate organic carbon (poc) and nitrogen (pon) in umol/L, long format (one row per sample x measurement_type).
